title: Schema.org PropertyValue
description: A property-value pair, e.g. representing a feature of a product or place.

propertyID.description: A commonly used identifier for the characteristic represented by the property.

unitCode.description: The unit of measurement given using the UN/CEFACT Common Code.

unitText.description: A string indicating the unit of measurement.

minValue.description: The lower value of some characteristic or property.

maxValue.description: The upper value of some characteristic or property.

measurementTechnique.description: A technique or technology used in a measurement.

valueReference.description: A pointer to a secondary value that provides additional information.
